Players Committee card image of [[Death Trooper (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “While you have no other trooper here (except death troopers), adds one battle destiny at same site as Krennic, Tarkin or Thrawn. May place this character in Used Pile to cancel a just drawn weapon destiny targeting your leader here.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/deathtrooper.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/eb9f1e88dd679e4fa7860bc7cc8b6032d3476e13 eb9f1e8] (22 April 2024). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
